compute_mesh_face_areas_and_normals: compute the areas and normals of each triangular face in a mesh given verts and faces tensors
compute_face_areas_for_backward_grads: compute face areas with autograd support so gradients flow back to vertex positions
compute_face_normals_for_backward_grads: compute face normals with autograd support so gradients flow back to vertex positions
review_MeshFaceAreasNormals_forward: review the _MeshFaceAreasNormals forward pass that validates verts and faces shapes then calls the C++ extension
review_MeshFaceAreasNormals_backward: review the _MeshFaceAreasNormals backward pass that computes gradients with respect to vertex positions
